runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records keep their own verifiedAt unless their public detail was actually reopened or otherwise reconfirmed.
runSummary.note: Real morning sweep on 10.9.2026 across Profesia, direct/company/Kariera sources, Worki, Brigada.sk, public LinkedIn/tech-creative discovery, Upwork and public communities. Two new active high-confidence eligible roles were promoted through a dated delta: SUPTel dispatcher administration and FINAL-CD OPEL service assistant. IKEA contact-centre aftersales, Slovak Telekom B2B support and finby admin were directly reopened and reverified. INDEX NOSLUS archive was also reopened but is now deliberately quarantined because the current detail explicitly requires physical fitness and includes pallet/loading work. Grafton complaint analyst was not promoted because the current detail requires English B1 plus technical degree/experience. No timestamp-only freshness was used.
